app.name: PhoneMail
app.tagline: Your phone number is your email address.

onboarding.termsText: Read our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>. Tap "Agree and continue" to accept the <terms>Terms of Service</terms>.
onboarding.verifyExplain: PhoneMail will need to verify your phone number. Carrier charges may apply.
onboarding.whatsMyNumberBody: Open your phone's Settings and look under About phone → Status (or SIM status). You can also dial your operator's code, for example *1# on Jio.
onboarding.passwordHint: New here? This becomes your new account's password (at least 8 characters).
onboarding.confirmNumberQuestion: Is this OK, or would you like to edit the number?
onboarding.findNumberBody: It makes signing up faster. You can still type it.
onboarding.waitingForSms: Waiting to automatically detect an SMS sent to {{phone}}.
onboarding.contactsBody: To show names instead of numbers, allow PhoneMail to use your contacts. You choose which contacts to share.

home.searchPlaceholder: Search or start a new chat
home.emptyBody: Search a phone number above, or tap the pencil to write an email.

emptyFilter.favorites: No favorites yet. Long-press a chat and tap the star.

home.notifyBody: We'll tell you even when PhoneMail is in the background.

folders.spamHint: Emails in Spam don't show up in your chats.
folders.trashHint: Emails in Trash are deleted for good after 30 days.
folders.emptyTrashBody: Every email in Trash will be deleted for good.

terms.intro: PhoneMail is a student project built for a hackathon. These terms are short on purpose.
terms.what: PhoneMail gives you an email address made from your phone number, plus optional aliases.
terms.free: It's free. There are no ads and no paid plans.
terms.use: Don't use PhoneMail to send spam, scams, threats or anything illegal. We may block accounts that do.
terms.content: You own what you write. We store your emails only to show them to you and to the people you write to.
terms.demo: This is a demo service: it can be reset, and it isn't meant for important mail.
terms.changes: If these terms change, the app will ask you to accept the new version.

privacy.intro: What we keep, and why, in plain words.
privacy.stored: We store your phone number, your emails and attachments, your profile (name, photo, about) and the devices you're signed in on.
privacy.sms: If you don't use the mobile app, we text you when an email arrives. Signing in on the app stops those texts.
privacy.noAds: We don't show ads, and we don't sell or share your data.
privacy.sharing: Contacts are only read if you pick them yourself, and only to show names instead of numbers.
privacy.security: Sign-in codes are stored scrambled (hashed), you can end any device's session from Settings, and emails are cleaned of harmful content before you see them.
privacy.deletion: To have your account and all its mail deleted, contact the PhoneMail team; we'll delete it within 7 days.

portal.subtitle: Your phone number becomes your email address.
portal.phoneHint: Outside India? Start with + and your country code.
portal.codeLocked: Send a code to your phone first.
portal.successBody: {{address}} is ready. Sign in on the PhoneMail app or on the web to read your email.
portal.resetting: This form clears in a few seconds for the next person.

demo.banner: Demo mode: codes and SMS are not really sent. They show up here instead.
demo.feedEmpty: Nothing sent yet. Register a number and its code appears here.
demo.off: The demo console is only available in demo mode.
demo.sendHint: It travels over real SMTP (port 2525) from an outside address, the way mail from Gmail would.
demo.phoneHint: Runs the same code as the real Twilio and SMSGate webhooks. New accounts and replies show up in the feed.
demo.calling: Twilio is calling that number now.

smsOutcome.created: Account created: {{address}}. A welcome SMS is on its way.
smsOutcome.existing: Already registered: {{address}}. A reminder SMS is on its way.
smsOutcome.help: A HELP reply is on its way.

errors.NETWORK: Can't reach PhoneMail. Check your connection.
errors.ALREADY_REGISTERED: This number already has a PhoneMail address. Sign in instead.
errors.OTP_EXPIRED: The code has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.OTP_INVALID: That code isn't right. Tries left: {{attemptsLeft}}.
errors.OTP_TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many wrong codes. Ask for a new one.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many tries. Wait {{seconds}} seconds and try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED_SOON: Too many tries. Wait a little and try again.
errors.OTP_UNAVAILABLE: Codes are switched off right now.
errors.SMS_UNAVAILABLE: We couldn't send an SMS right now. Try again soon.
errors.PASSWORD_NOT_SET: This account signs in with a code.
errors.PASSWORD_LOGIN_DISABLED: Sign in with a code sent by SMS.
errors.SESSION_REVOKED: For your safety, please sign in again.
errors.ALIAS_INVALID: Use 3–30 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores, starting with a letter.
errors.ALIAS_HELD: Someone used that name recently. Try another.
errors.ALIAS_LIMIT: You can have up to 5 aliases.
errors.INVALID_RECIPIENT: That's not a phone number or email address.
errors.RECIPIENT_NOT_FOUND: That number isn't on PhoneMail yet.
errors.RECIPIENTS_LOCKED: To add people, start a new email from Home.
errors.ALREADY_REPLIED: You've already replied to this email.
errors.ATTACHMENT_NOT_FOUND: An attachment is missing. Attach it again.
errors.SEND_FAILED: The email couldn't be sent. Try again.
